title: A CuTe DSL GEMM with a fused epilogue
brief: Build a tensor from a layout, partition a tile with a TiledCopy thread-value layout, then compile an Ampere CuTe DSL GEMM that fuses bias and GELU into the epilogue. The layout checks run on the CPU. The kernel runs on the A100.
hints: The first function is tensor_offsets. An integer coordinate into a nested shape is colexicographic: peel off coordinate mod product(mode) for every mode but the last.
partition_tiled_copy evaluates the thread-value layout at (thread, value). It does not assign element thread + value * num_threads.
accumulator_mn is the m16n8k16 table from chapter 13: m = floor(lane / 4) + 8 * floor(value / 2), n = 2 * (lane mod 4) + (value mod 2).
bias_gelu adds the bias, then applies the erf GELU. GELU then bias is a different function.

The kernel needs nvidia-cutlass-dsl 4.8.1, which the worker image already has. Build a TiledMMA from warp.MmaF16BF16Op and a TiledCopy with make_tiled_copy_tv, then call cute.copy and cute.gemm. Apply the epilogue to the accumulator before the global store.
The first DSL compile can take a few minutes. Later runs of the same source reuse the build. Shapes that are not multiples of the tile are padded with zeros on the host.
